name: fileReadLines
description: Reads several lines from a file into an array, without loading the whole file into memory. Reads from `startLine` to the end of the file when `count` is omitted.

params.name: file
params.description: Path to the file, or a file object returned by `fileOpen()`. Also accepted as `filepath` when passed as a named argument.

params.name: startLine
params.description: The 0-based line number to start reading from, so `0` is the first line. Adobe's docs list this as required, but CF2025 accepts the call without it and reads from the first line.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of lines to read. A negative value reads backward, returning that many lines before `startLine`. Omit to read to the end of the file.

examples.title: Read two lines
examples.description: `startLine` is 0-based, so `1` starts at the second line.

examples.title: Read backward
examples.description: A negative count returns the lines before `startLine`.
